title: Pilot Plan
description: The frontmatter of a pilot plan (XP): detailed instructions for builders to achieve a build goal, generated once a request has the commander's approval. The commander enacts approval on the plan itself; once frozen it is handed to a build specialist. Filed by identifier with a dash, XP-004.md.

type.description: the words Pilot Plan, which is what chooses this schema

unit.description: this plan's identifier, XP, a dash and three digits, the same identifier the file is named for

name.description: one to three words the writer chose for the record's contents, appended to the file name after the id (CA-049)

status.description: draft while the pilot may still remake it, frozen once the commander gives full approval and it can be handed to a build specialist, held while the commander has blocked it

approval.description: the commander's enacted approval: full (the pilot proceeds, and the plan can be handed to a build specialist), part (the commander added to or adjusted their own record, and the pilot redrafts against it), held (blocked from progressing), or empty while still awaiting the commander's word

stamp.description: three items: the date as YYYY-MM-DD, who wrote it, and the eight-character session id

context.description: the identifiers this plan builds against, a bracketed list, usually the approved request. The old Rq, P, Or and De forms are accepted only until XD-005's citation sweep replaces them

generates.description: the identifiers of what this plan led to, a bracketed list, usually the procedure or dispatch that carried it out. The old Rq, P, Or and De forms are accepted only until XD-005's citation sweep replaces them
